title: Auto-Grotto
description: Outputs accurate grotto coordinates for Crystal Hollows routing.
body:
GrottoHelper is a powerful utility mod for Minecraft Skyblock (1.8.9, Forge), designed to make finding and navigating grottos faster, easier, and more efficient. It enhances gameplay without altering the core mechanics of the game, giving you the authentic Skyblock experience while saving time and effort.

Unlike other automation or utility mods, GrottoHelper integrates seamlessly with Forge clients and most Skyblock tools, letting you focus on gameplay rather than hunting hidden grottos.

📥 Installation Guide

GrottoHelper requires Minecraft 1.8.9 with Forge. To install:

Install Forge 1.8.9 if you haven’t already.

Place GrottoHelper in your mods folder.

Launch Minecraft and use commands like /grotto scan or /stalk to confirm it’s working.

Most features are pre-configured for optimal performance. You can adjust settings only if you want to customize grotto detection ranges, player tracking options, or route exporting behavior.

✅ Hardware Compatibility

GrottoHelper is designed for desktop Java Edition on standard Minecraft hardware. Most modern systems will run it without issue. Older systems may experience reduced performance during world scanning.

🐛 Reporting Issues

Use the issue tracker on Modrinth to report bugs or crashes. Include your mod list and logs for faster resolution.

Note: Performance and detection accuracy may vary depending on world size, server performance, and hardware configuration.
